note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested (Antrim Rural, Ballyrobin, Crumlin, Seacash; already held). The returning officer's Notice of Result has not been found in BNA, so most uncontested divisions remain unnamed. Report of the council's annual meeting after the election: James Boyd succeeds Joseph Anderson (retired) as member for Craigarogan. Craigarogan was not among the four contested divisions (BO 18 May 1967 p1), and a new member cannot be deemed, so he was elected unopposed. Returned unopposed. Uncertain: unopposed status inferred (not stated) from the four-contest list plus 'succeeding Mr. Anderson ... as member for Craigarogan'; confirm against the notice of result if found.
